=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text thead "pair     dist    path\n"
text tarrow " -> "
global dist long 16
global nxt ulong 16
global has uchar 16
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note emitwi writes a signed n right-aligned in w columns (w at most 20)
fn emitwi n long w ulong to void
d = new uchar 21 32
i = ulong 21
v = n
if lt n 0
v = neg n
end
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add long 48 rem v 10
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
if lt n 0
i = sub i 1
put d i 45
end
if gt w sub 21 i
i = sub 21 w
end
emit part d i sub 21 i
end
note vertices 1..4 are stored as 0..3; has[i*4+j] marks a known distance, nxt the first hop
fn edge u ulong v ulong w long to void
i = add mul sub u 1 4 sub v 1
put dist i w
put has i 1
put nxt i sub v 1
end
note try k as an intermediate between i and j
fn via i ulong k ulong j ulong to void
ik = add mul i 4 k
kj = add mul k 4 j
ij = add mul i 4 j
if and eq get has ik 1 eq get has kj 1
d = add get dist ik get dist kj
if or eq get has ij 0 lt d get dist ij
put dist ij d
put has ij 1
put nxt ij get nxt ik
end
end
end
note path follows the next-hop table from i to j; a shortest path visits at most the 4 vertices
fn path i ulong j ulong to void
emitu add i 1
v = i
while ne v j bound 4
v = get nxt add mul v 4 j
emit tarrow
emitu add v 1
end
end
fn main to int
edge 1 3 -2
edge 2 1 4
edge 2 3 3
edge 3 4 2
edge 4 2 -1
for k ulong 4
for i ulong 4
for j ulong 4
via i k j
end
end
end
emit thead
for i ulong 4
for j ulong 4
if ne i j
emitu add i 1
emit tarrow
emitu add j 1
emitwi get dist add mul i 4 j 6
emit sp
emit sp
emit sp
emit sp
path i j
emit nl
end
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
pair     dist    path
1 -> 2    -1    1 -> 3 -> 4 -> 2
1 -> 3    -2    1 -> 3
1 -> 4     0    1 -> 3 -> 4
2 -> 1     4    2 -> 1
2 -> 3     2    2 -> 1 -> 3
2 -> 4     4    2 -> 1 -> 3 -> 4
3 -> 1     5    3 -> 4 -> 2 -> 1
3 -> 2     1    3 -> 4 -> 2
3 -> 4     2    3 -> 4
4 -> 1     3    4 -> 2 -> 1
4 -> 2    -1    4 -> 2
4 -> 3     1    4 -> 2 -> 1 -> 3
</pre>
